_comment: Site values (honeypot/site.py). Published code and data hold @@key@@ where one of these belongs. MADE-UP VALUES, each (but dev_*) as long as the real one. The code and the tests run on this file as it is; to run against a real lab, copy it to site.local.json and put that lab's values in.

_keys.ref_*: the reference machine (the real one the honeypot imitates): its addresses and MACs
_keys.hp_*: the honeypot's own machine (the gateway): its addresses and MACs, served instead of the reference's
_keys.lab_*, student_net: the lab network: subnet, router, jump host, IPv6 resolver; student_net is the class's network
_keys.influx_*: the InfluxDB credentials the simulated machine's container shows (Config.Env, the influx CLI)
_keys.dev_*: the development machine's user, home and host name: only for tools/publish_check.sh, which refuses a published file that holds one
